descripcion.es:
Encantadora Finca Andaluza con Elegancia Atemporal y Carácter Auténtico

Esta exquisita finca andaluza captura la verdadera esencia del sur de España, donde la artesanía tradicional se combina con el confort refinado. Cada detalle ha sido cuidadosamente diseñado, con azulejos artesanales, detalles en madera rústica y una estética cálida y armoniosa que refleja el auténtico estilo de vida andaluz.

La propiedad cuenta con dos amplios dormitorios, un baño elegantemente decorado con azulejos artesanales, y un gran salón con zona de biblioteca, un lugar perfecto para relajarse junto a la chimenea. Junto a esta zona, encontrará un amplio despacho, ideal para crear su oficina privada o espacio creativo.

La cocina andaluza tradicional es una de las joyas de la casa, auténtica y llena de encanto, complementada por un precioso comedor perfecto para disfrutar de comidas familiares o reuniones con amigos. Cada estancia mantiene un estilo andaluz coherente, combinando detalles rústicos con tonos suaves y un ambiente acogedor.

Al llegar a la finca, un camino ajardinado conduce a la entrada principal. A la derecha se encuentra el dormitorio principal, luminoso y sereno, con una gran ventana que da al jardín. Junto a él, el baño con ducha y azulejos artesanales. El segundo dormitorio también es muy luminoso y tiene vistas al jardín.

A la izquierda se encuentra el salón principal, con cómodos sofás, chimenea y ventanales que llenan el espacio de luz. Desde aquí, un pasillo conduce al comedor y a la cocina, y más adelante, a una amplia oficina, con posibilidad de instalar una lavandería.

El exterior cuenta con un jardín mediterráneo con naranjos, olivos, flores y arbustos, así como un huerto de frutas y verduras. La gran terraza cubierta con mobiliario confortable es ideal para disfrutar de veladas al aire libre. Desde la terraza, se accede a una piscina de 30 m² y a un césped amplio para pasear descalzo y relajarse.

descripcion.en:
Charming Andalusian Finca with Timeless Elegance and Authentic Character
This exquisite Andalusian finca captures the true essence of southern Spain — where traditional craftsmanship meets refined comfort. Every detail has been thoughtfully designed, featuring handmade ceramic tiles, rustic wooden accents, and a warm, harmonious aesthetic that reflects the authentic Andalusian lifestyle.

The property comprises two spacious bedrooms, one beautifully tiled bathroom, and a large living room with an elegant library area — a perfect setting to relax with a good book by the fireplace. Adjacent to the living area, you’ll find a bright and spacious study, ideal for creating your own private office or creative workspace.

The traditional Andalusian kitchen is a highlight of the home — full of charm and authenticity, complemented by a beautiful dining area perfect for enjoying family meals or gatherings with friends. Every room is designed with a consistent Andalusian style, combining rustic charm with soft tones and a cozy, inviting atmosphere.

As you approach the finca, a lovely garden pathway leads you to the entrance. Upon entering, to the right, you’ll find the master bedroom — bright, serene, and tastefully decorated in light shades, with a large window facing a peaceful part of the garden. Next to it lies the bathroom, featuring a walk-in shower and exquisite handmade tilework.
The second bedroom is also filled with natural light and overlooks the lush garden.

To the left, the main living room welcomes you with comfortable sofas, a charming fireplace, and large windows that flood the space with sunlight. Continuing through the hallway, you reach the spacious dining area and the beautifully appointed kitchen. Beyond the kitchen, there is a large office room, ideal for remote work or personal projects, with space to create a laundry area if desired.

Outside, the property is surrounded by a lush Mediterranean garden with orange trees, olive trees, colorful flowers, and fragrant shrubs. There is also a private fruit and vegetable garden, lovingly maintained by the owners.
A large covered terrace, elegantly furnished, provides the perfect spot to enjoy summer evenings with friends and family. From the terrace, steps lead down to a 30 m² swimming pool, ideal for relaxing, swimming, and sunbathing. The property also features a large lawn area, perfect for strolling barefoot and enjoying the tranquility of nature.

Prime Location in Marbella’s Golden Triangle

This Andalusian retreat enjoys a privileged location just a few minutes from some of Marbella’s finest spots:
 • 2–3 minutes from Parque de Nagüeles, a beautiful natural park where you can take peaceful walks, have picnics, or enjoy a barbecue surrounded by nature.
 • 10 minutes from Playa de Nagüeles, a stunning beach where you can relax on sun loungers and enjoy the Mediterranean Sea.
 • 5 minutes from Organic Market & Food Marbella, perfect for those who appreciate healthy, organic cuisine and refreshing drinks.
 • 15 minutes from the world-famous Puente Romano Tennis Club, one of Marbella’s most prestigious sports destinations.
 • 15 minutes from Aloha Golf Club and 20 minutes from Los Naranjos Golf Club, two internationally renowned golf courses.
 • 20 minutes from Los Naranjos Padel Club, for padel enthusiasts.
 • 10 minutes from Puerto Banús, known for its luxury boutiques, fine dining restaurants, and vibrant marina atmosphere.
 • 15 minutes from Marbella city centre, where you can park easily at Indigo Parking and enjoy a stroll along the promenade with a variety of restaurants offering international cuisine.
 • And just 15 minutes from the famous Trocadero Playa, one of Marbella’s most iconic beachfront restaurants.

This property is the perfect ‌blend ‌of ‌authentic ‌Andalusian ‌charm, ‌comfort, and ‌an unbeatable ‌location — an ideal home ‌or ‌holiday ‌retreat ‌for ‌those seeking elegance, privacy, ‌and ‌the ‌essence ‌of ‌the ‌Mediterranean ‌lifestyle.
